reasons: CS3240 requires CS2111 or NM2207; NM2207 is blocked by completed CS1101S, so CS2111 is added as the required prerequisite.
CS2111 is offered only in Sem 2, so it is placed in semester 6; CS3240 is offered only in Sem 1, so the earliest possible placement is semester 7.
CS2102 and CS3219 are both eligible and offered in the remaining semesters; placing one in semester 5 and one in semester 8 keeps one module per semester and keeps CS3219 separate from CS3240.
